name: Zhores Barsoukova
original_name: ジョレス・バルスコワ
source:
Louise's target. 

A Russian spy, nicknamed the "Ice Queen." He poses as an ordinary librarian. He takes advantage of the postwar confusion to send vital information back to the Soviet Union. He is a skilled gunman and swordsman. 

[From in-game profile]
